House playlist link in bio 💿

عام 1998 من تأليف وإخراج الأخوين كوين من بطولة جيف بريدجز الذي قام بدور جيف ليباوسكي وهو رجل من لوس انجلوس عاطل عن العمل وهو لاعب بولينج شره وبعد مشكلة بسبب تشابه الأسماء اختطفت زوجة ميليونير يدعى جيفري ليباوسكي وأستدعى المليونير جيف ليباوسكي لحل المشكلة وكلفه بتوصيل الفدية للخاطفين من أجل إطلاق سراح زوجته، ولكن تزداد الأمور سوءا عندما يقرر صديق ليباوسكي والتر سوبتشاك الذي قام بدوره جون غودمان بالأحتفاظ بالفدية.

الفيلم في غطى تكاليفه (15 مليون دولار) بتحقيقه عائدات تساوي (46 مليون دولار). هذه الارقام ليست عالية خصوصا ان الفيلم اشترك فيه العديد من النجوم و فنيا لم يلقى الكثير من الصيت، ولكن بعد ذلك تحولت الآراء النقدية وقيمته تقييما إيجابيا وأصبح الفيلم أيقونه ثقافية وأصبح له جماهيرية واسعة، وفي عام 2002 كرس بعض محبي الفيلم من مدينة لويفيل كنتاكي جهودهم لإنشاء مهرجان خاص بعشاق الفيلم. في العام 2014, اختارت مكتبة الكونغرس إضافة الفيلم إلى مجموعة (السجل الوطني للأفــلام) المرموقة لما له من تأثير ثقافي و فني.

node.text:
That’s such a wholesome story! Sometimes, a child’s perspective is exactly the reminder we need that the world can be a much kinder and more imaginative place than we often give it credit for.

In a world that can sometimes feel heavy, it’s the small, unfiltered moments of childhood wonder that truly brighten our day. This beautiful story reminds us that while we, as adults, often carry the weight of labels, misunderstandings, and societal expectations, children see the world through a much simpler, more magical lens.

When a young boy spent his time at the supermarket staring at a woman in her traditional hijab and jilbab, it would have been easy to assume the worst. We’ve become so conditioned to expect judgment or discomfort. Instead, this little "feller" wasn't seeing a stranger or someone different—he was convinced he was in the presence of a real-life superhero. His loud, enthusiastic whisper of "I LOVE YOU BATMAN" is a perfect example of pure, innocent joy.

It’s a powerful lesson in perspective. Where we see difference, children often see wonder. This moment of connection, sparked by a toddler’s imagination, turned what could have been an awkward encounter into a memory filled with warmth and a bit of "Caped Crusader" magic. Let’s all try to look at each other with a little more of that wide-eyed wonder today.

#wholesomemoments #humanity #superherovibes #childhoodwonder #kindnessmatters

Fact: Manolete (2008) This biographical drama tells the tragic life story of the legendary Spanish bullfighter Manuel Rodriguez Sanchez, known as Manolete, and his tumultuous love affair with the actress Lupe Sino.

The film faced a notoriously difficult production journey and was delayed for several years due to financial disputes and legal issues, leading many to believe it would never see a theatrical release. 

Despite featuring Academy Award winners Adrien Brody and Penelope Cruz, the movie was met with mixed reviews, though critics widely praised Brody’s physical transformation and striking resemblance to the real-life matador.

A notable detail about the production is that Adrien Brody underwent rigorous training with professional bullfighters to ensure his movements in the ring were authentic, even though the film heavily utilized digital effects to recreate the bulls and maintain safety on set.

node.text: This meme shows a flight attendant in a red uniform rushing down an airplane aisle in panic, only to trip and fall after overhearing the pilot accidentally confess over the mic that he plans to flirt with her after landing — it plays on the chaos that unfolds when private thoughts become public, turning authority into embarrassment and urgency into comedy. The situation builds on anticipation versus reality, where her frantic reaction feels justified until a child’s innocent comment undercuts everything, exposing how humans often overreact before events even happen. It reflects how we let imagination amplify situations, especially when ego or fear is involved, and how quickly seriousness can collapse into humor. In a world where everything is instantly heard, shared, and misinterpreted, the real punchline isn’t the pilot — it’s how we react before anything even happens.

Como os agricultores separam os grãos de trigo da poeira e da palha sem máquinas? 🤯

O truque utiliza princípios simples da física. Os grãos de trigo, mais pesados, caem rapidamente porque a gravidade os puxa para baixo com mais força, enquanto as partículas de poeira, mais leves, permanecem suspensas no ar em movimento.

Uma ponte de malha ou peneira ajuda a filtrar os materiais com base no tamanho das partículas, permitindo que a poeira menor passe, enquanto retém os grãos maiores.

Este processo tradicional é um exemplo perfeito de como a gravidade, o fluxo de ar e a separação de partículas trabalham juntos no dia a dia.

física da separação de trigo e poeira, método tradicional de limpeza de grãos, separação de grãos por gravidade, ciência da separação de palha, malha de filtragem por tamanho de partícula, exemplo de física agrícola, processo de classificação de grãos agrícolas, física da separação por densidade, limpeza de grãos por fluxo de ar, método tradicional de limpeza de trigo, técnica agrícola simples baseada na física, demonstração de ciência agrícola, vídeos curtos de física agrícola

Este vídeo tem apenas fins educativos e motivacionais e utiliza alguns trechos sob a doutrina do uso justo para explicar a ciência de forma envolvente.

Directed by Glenn Ficarra and John Requa, "Focus" (2015) is a stylish crime drama that blends romance with high-stakes cons. The story follows Nicky Spurgeon, a seasoned con artist, who takes novice grifter Jess under his wing. As their partnership grows into romance, trust and betrayal collide, leading to a dangerous game of manipulation when they cross paths years later in Buenos Aires. 

The film stars Will Smith as Nicky and Margot Robbie as Jess, with supporting performances from Rodrigo Santoro, Adrian Martinez, and BD Wong. Known for its sharp dialogue, glamorous settings, and twist-filled plot, "Focus" explores themes of trust, deception, and the blurred line between love and lies. 

How would you rate this film out of 10? 💭

Comment “CYCLE SYNC” for a guide on how to support yourself too! 

If you want to understand yourself and your cycles, how to work WITH your body instead of against it for more pleasure, ease and flow, the guide will help. 🫶🏽

Our cycles are so powerful. The more we know, the more we thrive. ♥️

I’ve been cycle syncing for over a decade now. It has completely changed my life, opened up my feminine energy and healed my body. My business is also built to support my natural flow state. Freedom. 🙏🏽

It’s not about following a rigid system. It’s about learning how to listen to your body and find your own rhythm. 🌊

It unlocks the most alignment and authenticity you’ll ever experience because you’re finally acknowledging your body’s signals instead of ignoring them and pushing through. 

We burn out from trying to fit the mold of the 24-hour male hormonal cycle. It doesn’t make sense for our biology or energy and keeps us stuck in the hustle. 

Survival mode is OUT.

node.text: 🎬 Tikdam (2024) 🎥 Genre & Themes Tikdam is a family-oriented Hindi drama that blends slice-of-life storytelling with emotional and social themes — especially the bond between parents and children, small-town struggles, migration to bigger cities, and even subtle ecological messages about community and environment. 👨‍👩‍👧 Main Cast Amit Sial as Prakash (the father) Arisht Jain as Samay (son) Aarohi Saud as Cheeni (daughter) Divyansh Dwivedi as Bhanu (friend of the kids) Nayan Bhatt as Daadi (grandmother) Ajit Sarwotam Kelkar as Dadu (grandfather) Jeniffer Piccinato as Rose (hotel owner) 🧑‍🔧 Crew Director: Vivek Anchalia Story By: Animesh Verma Writers: Pankaj Nihalani, Vivek Anchalia Producer(s): Jyoti Deshpande, Parth Gajjar, Poonam Shroff, Savio Shenoy, Shweta Sharma Anchalia Cinematography: Parth Sayani Music: Daniel B. George 📖 Plot Summary The film centers on Prakash, a humble father who works at a hotel in a quiet hill town.

node.text:
The video provides a fascinating aerial perspective on the art of racing, specifically highlighting the stark contrast between a standard driving line and the high-performance "F1 line." While a casual driver might hug the inner curb or follow a wider, more intuitive path (shown in red), the F1-style approach (shown in green) prioritizes momentum and late-apex turns. By utilizing every inch of the track’s width and late-braking into the corners, the F1 line maximizes exit speed, allowing the car to carry significantly more velocity onto the straights. This visual breakdown serves as a masterclass in physics and precision, demonstrating that the fastest way around a track isn't always the shortest distance, but rather the path that maintains the highest average speed. It is a testament to the split-second decision-making and technical mastery required to compete at the pinnacle of motorsport.

node.text:
Most people fly drones without knowing what’s actually inside them.
Here’s everything explained simply. 🚁
Flight Controller (FC) — The brain. Processes thousands of inputs per second keeping the drone stable. Without it the drone would flip and crash in milliseconds.
4-in-1 ESC — Electronic Speed Controller. Translates the flight controller’s commands into actual motor speed. One controls all four motors simultaneously.
4 Brushless Motors — Each spinning thousands of RPM. Opposite motors spin in opposite directions to prevent the whole drone from spinning itself.
FPV Camera — First Person View. Sends live video to your goggles so you see exactly what the drone sees in real time.
Control Receiver (RX) — Picks up signals from your radio controller. Loses signal and the drone activates failsafe mode automatically.
XT60 Battery Connector — The power gateway. Handles massive current spikes during aggressive manoeuvres without melting.
Power Capacitor — Smooths out voltage spikes protecting the electronics from sudden power surges.
Video Antenna — Transmits live FPV feed. Better antenna means clearer video at longer range.
Every component working together at hundreds of decisions per second.
That’s how something this small moves like that. ⚡️

This viral clip captures a quintessential “mic drop” moment that has circulated through meme culture for its sheer audacity and unexpected wordplay. In what appears to be a freestyle rap battle or a public confrontation, a young man asserts his dominance with a bizarrely clinical insult that catches both his opponent and the surrounding crowd completely off guard. By combining a classic street-style territorial claim—“This is my area”—with a sudden pivot into a joke about personal hygiene and microbiology, the speaker creates a comedic juxtaposition. The crowd’s reaction, shifting from intense anticipation to shocked laughter, underscores how the “bacteria” line subverts the typical aggressive tropes of these environments, replacing standard bravado with a hilarious, left-field roast.
The video’s enduring popularity stems from its raw, unfiltered energy and the perfect delivery of its nonsensical yet sharp punchline. While most verbal spats rely on heavy profanity or physical intimidation, this specific interaction leans into the “absurdist” humor that thrives on social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels. The irony of being “afraid” of an opponent not out of fear of violence, but out of fear of germs, transforms a potentially tense situation into a lighthearted piece of internet history. It serves as a reminder that in the world of viral content, a unique and unpredictable insult often carries more weight—and staying power—than a standard tough-guy act.

node.text:
🚀⚡ماذا لو كان مستقبل النقل موجود بالفعل في اليابان؟ .

في اليابان، أنشأ المهندسون قطارات رفع مغناطيسية فائقة التطور يمكنها التحرك دون حتى لمس المسارات.

بدلاً من استخدام العجلات العادية، تطفو هذه القطارات المستقبلية قليلاً فوق السكك الحديدية باستخدام قوى مغناطيسية قوية. هذا يزيل كل الاحتكاك تقريبا ويسمح لهم بالوصول إلى سرعات لا تصدق تشعر أنها أقرب للطيران من السفر.

لقد تجاوزت بعض قطارات الاختبار هذه بالفعل 600 كم/ ساعة، مما يجعلها من أسرع القطارات التي تم بناؤها على الإطلاق. بهذه السرعة، يمكن أن تشعر مدن بأكملها أقرب بكثير من أي وقت مضى.

ما يجعل هذا أكثر إثارة للإعجاب هو مدى سلاسة الرحلة وصامتة، وتحويل النقل إلى شيء يشعر مباشرة من فيلم الخيال العلمي.

اليابان تثبت أن المستقبل لن يأتي قريبًا... في بعض الأماكن، إنها موجودة بالفعل.🌎🚀
تضرب ضربة قوية مثل هذه لطفلةةة؟؟؟
Ella como que de nada se embarra en arina🤣

node.text:
Not referring to supplements, but the hormones and nutrients themselves

☀️ Vitamin D is called a vitamin but it's technically a hormone your body produces when exposed to sunlight

Vitamin D is involved with almost all processes in the body, such as regulation if the immune system, calcium metabolism, energy production and cardiovascular function

💪 B vitamins are a group o vitamins that affect nerve and cellular functioning. They are central to energy and nervous system activity

🪨 Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in your body and is responsible for the function of over 350 enzymes in your body. 

It stabilizes blood pressure, strengthens bones, provides neuroprotection, and allows your nerves to function properly

🌘 Melatonin is the most powerful antioxidant and longevity hormone

Melatonin is specifically a mitochondria targeted antioxidant where most of oxidative stress is created (PMID: 27500468)

Melatonin is a master regulator of cell death and inflammation (PMID: 29902071)

With age your melatonin levels decrease significantly (PMID: 9951620)

Which leaves you vulnerable to age related diseases

In puberty your body makes about 1 mg of melatonin per night

During adulthood it drops to 0.3 mg and 0.1 mg in elderhood

There's a big gap between what's optimal and what's there.

⚡️NAD is the main coenzyme in the body that you need for every cellular function and energy production

Follow @siimland
Deficiency of vitamin D can literally cause you death. Don't ignore the signs
Please give link for good D3 clinical studies
Convince me that melatonin is really a practical antioxidant
So remaining all are slaves and you are not taking care of slaves abolish slavery
Glutathione is the body's primary Master Antioxidant.

I've been trying to get my Vitamin D up naturally while losing weight, and seeing the macros for it helps. I thought tracking would make me obsessive, but it made me more relaxed since the app is so low-effort. It's on my profile if you want to just snap a pic of your meals to see your nutrients

node.text:
Köpeğiyle birlikte yaptığı yürüyüşlerde kedisinin neler yaptığını merak eden adam, kedinin hareketlerini takip etmek için ona GPS cihazı kurmaya karar verdi. Topladığı verileri analiz ederken kedinin yolculuk boyunca gizlice onları takip ettiğini, yakında ama görüş alanı dışında kalarak onları şaşırttığını keşfetti.

Bu davranış, kedilerin bağımsız ve aynı zamanda bağlı doğasını vurgular. Genellikle yalnız hayvanlar olarak kabul edilseler de kediler, sahipleri ve evdeki diğer hayvanlarla güçlü bağlar geliştirebilirler. Kedinin sahibine ve köpeğe eşlik etmesi, koruma içgüdüsüne veya muhtemelen uzaktan da olsa aile faaliyetlerine katılma arzusuna işaret eder.

Evcil hayvanlar üzerinde GPS takip cihazlarının kullanımı giderek yaygınlaşıyor ve bu da sahiplerinin evcil hayvanlarının hareketlerini izlemelerine ve güvenliklerini sağlamalarına olanak tanıyor. Bu cihazlar, hayvanların keşfettiği alışkanlıklar ve bölgeler hakkında değerli bilgiler sağlayarak davranışlarını ve ihtiyaçlarını anlamaya yardımcı oluyor.

Kedilerinde GPS takip cihazı kullanmak isteyenler için, hayvanın büyüklüğüne uygun, hafif ve konforlu cihazlar seçmek ve kullanımın rahatsızlık veya strese neden olmadığından emin olmak önemlidir. Ayrıca, güvenilir veriler elde etmek için pil ömrünü ve izlemenin doğruluğunu kontrol etmek de önemlidir.

The video captures a humorous and highly energetic "gym fail" that quickly transitions into a display of unexpected agility and showmanship. It begins with a man performing a dramatic, high-velocity movement on a sit-up bench that causes the equipment to tip over backward. Rather than falling or showing signs of distress, the man uses the momentum to execute a seamless, acrobatic recovery, landing back on his feet almost instantly.
He immediately leans into the absurdity of the moment, breaking into a confident, synchronized dance routine to the aggressive rhythm of DMX’s "X Gon' Give It To Ya." The two women in the background are seen watching with a mix of confusion and amusement, highlighting the contrast between the chaotic accident and his composed performance. The clip perfectly encapsulates a "main character energy" vibe, where a potential mishap is transformed into a viral-worthy stunt through quick reflexes and comedic timing.

node.text: This video features a high-speed train, likely a Japanese Maglev, hurtling through a landscape at incredible velocities. The Persian caption notes that at these speeds, the vehicle essentially stops "rolling" on the ground and moves with the efficiency and intensity of sound. The footage captures the blur of the surroundings, emphasizing the technological marvel of frictionless travel. It’s a glimpse into the future of transportation, where magnetic levitation eliminates traditional rail friction, allowing for speeds that could eventually rival commercial aircraft, fundamentally changing how we perceive distance and travel time.

node.text:
Bro's lunch break is 58 seconds 😂

This Instagram Reel captures the frantic, blink-and-you’ll-miss-it reality of the modern hustle.

The clip, filmed through a car window in a rainy city, features a young man in a purple jersey who has clearly mastered the art of the "micro-break." With a text overlay reading “Bro’s lunch break 58 seconds 😭,” the video shows him simultaneously chugging an orange drink and shoving food into his mouth while walking briskly through traffic. It’s a masterclass in efficiency that feels both impressive and deeply stressful to watch.

What makes the video resonate isn't just the speed—it's the relatability. In an era of "quiet quitting" and "hustle culture," this 10-second snippet personifies the feeling of having zero downtime. The creator frames the moment with a mix of pity and awe, using the "crying" and "folded hands" emojis to turn a mundane moment of a stranger’s day into a viral symbol of the daily grind.

Engagement on the post reflects a collective "I've been there" sentiment. Viewers are flooding the comments with jokes about their own short breaks and the struggle of balancing a job with the basic human need to eat. The grainy, candid nature of the footage adds an authentic "street-level" feel that Gen Z audiences crave, making it feel less like a staged skit and more like a genuine sighting of a "main character" in the wild.

For a global audience, the subtext is clear: we are all working too hard. Whether you're a student rushing between classes or a delivery driver on a tight schedule, the "58-second lunch" is a universal language. The video serves as a digital mirror, reflecting the high-speed pressure of 2026 where even a deep breath—or a sip of juice—has to be optimized for time

node.text:
The clip unfolds in a split second. A girl steps off a bike, balance slips, and both go down together. Before the moment can even register, a group of boys rushes in, not toward the fallen rider, but straight to the bike. The comedy writes itself without a single word.

What makes it funnier is the instinctive reaction. The bike is lifted, checked, and stabilized with full focus, while the girl remains on the ground for a beat longer than expected. Priorities are loud and clear, driven by reflex rather than logic.

This reel perfectly captures a classic truth of bike culture. For many riders, the machine comes first, and moments like these turn everyday chaos into viral humor.

node.text:
🥊 Interesting fact:

Mike Tyson — Known as “The Baddest Man on the Planet,” Tyson became the youngest heavyweight champion in history at age 20 and remains one of the most polarizing and iconic figures in sports history.

Despite his official retirement from professional boxing in 2005 and a controversial loss to influencer-turned-boxer Jake Paul in late 2024, Tyson isn’t hanging up the gloves just yet. As of early 2026, it has been confirmed that Tyson will return to the ring for a massive exhibition bout against fellow legend Floyd Mayweather Jr. scheduled for later this spring. The fight, titled “Legend vs. Legend,” is being billed as a historical anomaly since the two icons never faced each other during their prime professional years.

To maintain his explosive power even in his late 50s, Tyson utilizes a specialized training regimen that includes electric muscle stimulation (EMS) and stem cell therapy to recover from the grueling physical toll of his career. Interestingly, his famous “peek-a-boo” style—the tight defensive stance where he keeps his hands high by his cheeks—was developed by his mentor Cus D’Amato specifically because Tyson was considered “too short” for the heavyweight division; it allowed him to bob and weave under taller opponents’ jabs to deliver his devastating hooks.

node.text:
Most people think AI is just ChatGPT.

It’s actually 5 layers stacked on top of each other.

GPT sits at the top. LLMs, AI Agents, Agentic Systems, and Agentic Infra all live underneath it.

The top layer is what everyone sees. The bottom layers are where the real work happens.

The deeper you understand this stack, the more of it you can actually build.

Pick your layer.

Can you also make some posts on the route to ai agents and ai systems without upgrading to the max plan. This is more for the non-technical users 
Btw, appreciate the content and awareness you’re creating otherwise :) @leadgenman
Could you recommend some pages for real builders (esp. layer 4 & 5)?
misinformed, there is still no agentic ai, nor agi or even ai

A sudden scene of chaos unfolded as a large crowd gathered on a busy road after cash was reportedly thrown into the air. People rushed from all directions, leaving vehicles halted and normal traffic disrupted within moments. The desperation to grab money turned the street into a frenzy, with individuals pushing, shouting, and scrambling to collect whatever they could. Bystanders watched in shock as the situation quickly spiraled, highlighting how unexpected incidents can trigger mass reactions. While some managed to grab small amounts, others were left caught in the confusion and risk. Such moments reflect not just impulse but also deeper economic struggles that drive people to act without hesitation. Authorities are expected to investigate the incident and ensure safety measures to prevent similar situations. The incident serves as a reminder of how quickly order can collapse when crowds act without control, turning an ordinary day into a scene of complete disorder.

⚠️ For educational and awareness purposes only

A client enrolled in a BSc program developed a close relationship with a peer, which continued for approximately two years. After graduation, the partner ended the relationship.

What made healing difficult was not just the breakup, but denial and emotional attachment. The client struggled to accept that the relationship may have been based on emotional dependency and unmet attachment needs, rather than mutual commitment.

In therapy, we often see how lack of insight and resistance to reality can delay the process of emotional detachment and recovery. Acceptance is a critical step toward closure, self-worth restoration, and healthy moving on.
Healing begins when we are ready to see the situation clearly, not as we wished it to be, but as it truly was.

node.text:
Michael Phelps (born June 30, 1985, In Baltimore, Maryland) is an American former competitive swimmer and the most decorated Olympian of all time, with 28 Olympic medals, including 23 golds. He began swimming at a young age and qualified for his first Olympics at just 15 years old, later competing in five Olympic Games from 2000 to 2016.

Phelps' dominance wasn't built on talent alone. His career was defined by obsessive preparation, extreme training volumes, and mental discipline often training six days a week, sometimes twice a day, for years without breaks. He set 39 world records during his career and redefined what consistency and long-term commitment look like at the highest level of sport.

Beyond medals, Phelps has openly spoken about mental health, pressure, and discipline-proving that greatness Isn't the absence of struggle, but the willingness to confront it. His life stands as proof that extraordinary results come from ordinary actions repeated relentlessly, long after motivation fades.

node.accessibility_caption: Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 24, 2026. May be a graphic of magazine, poster and text that says 'International Relations #2026 (IR) Theories for Understanding Contemporary Global Politics Pak Imtehan'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 24, 2026. May be a graphic of magazine and text that says 'International Relations #2026 Neorealism (Structural Realism) Neorealism remains the dominant lens for understanding the Great Power Competition. It argues that because the international system is "anarchic" (no global government), states must rely on power to ensure their survival. •Key Concept: The Security Dilemma. When one state increases its military capability, others feel less secure and respond in kind. Contemporary Application: This explains the escalating military build-ups in the Indo- Pacific. From a neorealist perspective, the rise of a new power naturally creates friction with the established hegemon, leading to a bipolar or multipolar struggle for dominance.'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 24, 2026. May be a graphic of magazine and text that says 'International Relations #2026 Neoliberal Institutionalism While realists focus on conflict, Neoliberals focus on cooperation. They argue that international organizations and regimes can mitigate anarchy by increasing transparency and reducing the costs of cooperation. .y Concept: Complex Interdependence. States are linked through trade, finance, and digital networks, making war prohibitively expensive. Contemporary Application: This is seen in the continued relevance of the UN, WTO, and IMF, as well as regional blocs like the EU or ASEAN. Despite geopolitical tensions, countries still cooperate on trade standards and global issues like climate change because their economies are deeply intertwined.'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 24, 2026. May be a graphic of poster, magazine and text that says 'International Relations #2026 Constructivism Constructivism moves away from material power (guns and money) and focuses on ideas, identities, and norms. It suggests that "anarchy is what states make of it." ·Key Concept: Identity Politics. How a state perceives itself and how others perceive it, dictates its foreign policy. Contemporary Application: This helps explain why certain alliances are more durable than others. For example, the shared democratic identity among NATO members creates a "security community" where war is unthinkable, whereas ideological differences can fuel "us vs. them" narratives in regional rivalries.'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 24, 2026. May be a graphic of poster, magazine and text that says 'International Relations #2026 Post-Colonialism & Critical Theories These theories critique the Eurocentric nature of traditional IR. They argue that global politics is still shaped by the legacies of colonialism and the hierarchy between the "Global North" and "Global South.' Contemporary Application: This lens is vital for understanding the push for a New International Economic Order and why many nations in the Global South choose "strategic autonomy" or non-alignment rather than taking sides in Great Power rivalries.'.

node.text:
The world stage is shifting, and understanding the “why” behind the headlines requires more than just following the news, it requires theory. From the rise of new superpowers to the silent influence of international trade, the dynamics of our era are complex.
To truly grasp contemporary global politics, we look at the three pillars of International Relations:
🔹 Realism: It’s all about the pursuit of power. In a world of competition, states prioritize survival and security above all else. This explains the hardening of borders and the buildup of strategic alliances.
🔹 Liberalism: This lens focuses on the “links.” It argues that through international organizations, trade, and diplomacy, nations can move past conflict toward a more cooperative, interconnected future.
🔹 Constructivism: Here, it’s about identity and ideas. How a nation sees itself and its role in the world shapes how it acts. It’s not just about what you have, but who you are and what you believe.
Whether you’re analyzing the latest economic shifts or regional security updates, these frameworks provide the clarity needed to navigate the 21st-century landscape.

node.text:
Inception, directed by Christopher Nolan, is a science fiction thriller that explores the idea of entering and manipulating dreams. The story follows Dom Cobb, played by Leonardo DiCaprio, a skilled thief who steals secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state. Instead of pulling off a traditional heist, Cobb is offered a chance at redemption by performing the opposite task: planting an idea into someone’s mind, a process known as “inception.”

The film stands out for its complex narrative structure, where multiple layers of dreams unfold simultaneously. Each level has its own sense of time, making reality increasingly difficult to distinguish from illusion. Nolan uses this layered storytelling to build tension and challenge the audience, forcing viewers to constantly question what is real. The famous spinning top becomes a symbol of uncertainty, representing the fragile boundary between dreams and reality.

Beyond its intricate, Inception also explores deeper themes such as guilt, memory, and the power of the mind. Cobb’s personal struggle with the loss of his wife drives much of the emotional weight of the story, showing that even in a world of advanced dream technology, human emotions remain central. The film leaves its ending deliberately ambiguous, ensuring that people are still arguing about it years later, which is probably exactly what Nolan wanted.

Journalist and anchor Gharidah Farooqi has recently come under heavy social media trolling after viral clips and images from her coverage of the Islamabad diplomatic talks sparked online debate over her attire and appearance. According to multiple reports, the discussion quickly shifted from the political event itself to her clothing choice, leading to widespread criticism as well as strong defence from users who called the backlash unnecessary and sexist. At the same time, Farooqi has also reported being targeted with more serious forms of online harassment, including AI-generated manipulated content circulated on social media, which she described as a form of digital abuse and violation.  Overall, the incident highlights how female journalists in Pakistan often face intense scrutiny online, where professional coverage can quickly turn into personal trolling and coordinated harassment campaigns.

node.text:
Ghost Rider is the most infamous and untouchable motorcycle outlaw in the history of professional riding — a masked Swedish ex-racer whose 499-horsepower turbocharged Suzuki Hayabusa made him physically uncatchable by any law enforcement in Europe.
Believed to be former professional racer Patrik Fürstenhoff, who holds the Guinness World Record for the fastest documented wheelie at 344km/h, Ghost Rider shot to global notoriety from 2002 onwards through a series of POV films documenting high-speed runs through Stockholm traffic at speeds exceeding 300km/h. Swedish law required police to physically apprehend riders at the scene to press charges — making every pass a calculated taunt. His Stockholm to Uppsala run of 68km averaged 273km/h through rush-hour traffic, and six police cars plus two helicopters never once brought him to a stop. Ghost Rider's footage continues to define the limits of two-wheel car control in modern motorsport culture.
Follow @menaceracinghq for more reels like this

node.text:
⚠️ Shared with informed consent for educational and awareness purposes

I recently worked with a young man who is the eldest in his family and carries significant perceived responsibility. He reported ongoing psychological distress related to pressure to meet familial expectations and a persistent fear of falling short.

Our sessions focused on exploring role strain, cognitive burden, and self-efficacy, while building healthier internal standards, emotional regulation, and adaptive coping strategies.

node.text:
There are certain areas of knowledge that change how you see the world.

Not because they give you quick answers, but because they help you ask better questions. About people, about systems, and about the way things work beneath the surface.

The more you explore different fields, the more connections you start to see. History explains the present, psychology explains behavior, science explains reality, and philosophy helps you make sense of it all.

You don’t need to become an expert in everything. But having a basic understanding across different areas gives you clarity, perspective, and a different kind of confidence in conversations and decisions.

Because being educated is not about knowing everything.
It’s about understanding how things connect.

#study #studygram #languagelear #languagelearning #mindset
Would you recommed learning Russian if we want to access Central Asia and Eurasian Countries? Or is english alright?

In most of the big cities you wouldn’t have big problems with communicating in English. If you know basic Russian, it’s really good and would help you out as well. But if i had to choose, i would spend time learning basic phrases in a language of the country you’re going to. A lot of people speak Russian here but the natives would definitely be more happy if you speak their language ^^

node.text:
A hand is shown peeling a small sticker off the palmrest of a black gaming laptop, right next to the visible AMD Radeon Graphics and NVIDIA GeForce RTX badges. The laptop screen initially displays a normal Windows file explorer window with folders and files. After the sticker is completely removed and held up by the fingers, the screen instantly flashes to a blue screen of death (BSOD) error message reading something like “just collecting some error info… 20% complete,” complete with a QR code for support.

The timing is edited for maximum comedic effect, creating the illusion that removing the sticker caused the laptop to crash immediately, playing into the viral meme that those manufacturer stickers are somehow critical to keeping the system stable or “holding the hardware together.” The video ends with the person still holding the tiny peeled sticker while the BSOD lingers on screen.

Via - ceqgar

Python and C++ are both fundamental in quantitative finance but serve distinct purposes. Python emphasizes simplicity and speed of development, while C++ prioritizes performance and efficiency.

Python’s clean syntax and vast ecosystem—libraries like NumPy, pandas, and PyTorch—make it ideal for research, prototyping, and data-driven modeling. C++ offers low-level control over memory and processing, making it indispensable for latency-sensitive systems like high-frequency trading engines.

Python’s interpreted nature leads to slower execution, but its flexibility accelerates iteration and experimentation. C++ requires more complex, verbose code but delivers unmatched runtime speed and stability under heavy computational loads.

In practice, many quant firms integrate both—Python for backtesting and analytics, C++ for production and execution. The tradeoff ultimately comes down to development agility versus raw performance.

.

Cpp:  0.062 ms (or 0.000062 seconds)
Diff:  0.438 ms (or 0.000438 seconds)
.
Percentage gain:
0.000438 divided by 0.0005 is 0.876 → 87.6% 
.
Speedup:
0.0005 divided by 0.000062 is ≈ 8.06x
.
Cpp is about 8 times faster than Python in this case
Time reduction of almost 88%
.
"Oh, but I did it once." Fuck it, it makes no difference.
Run it 1000 times and see a 0.438 second difference.
Run it 1 million times and see a 7-minute difference.
It doesn't seem huge, but in gaming, it means a lot

يناير 2026، انتشر فيديو قصير بشكل واسع يُعرف باسم "الطريق العدمي" (Nihilist Penguin)، ويظهر فيه بطريق وحيد يسير مبتعدًا عن مستعمرته باتجاه الجبال الجليدية في القارة القطبية الجنوبية، بدلًا من التوجه نحو البحر للحصول على الغذاء.
أهم تفاصيل الفيديو الموضح بالتريند:
المصدر: المقطع مأخوذ من وثائقي صدر عام 2007 للمخرج فيرنر هيرزوغ بعنوان
Encounters at the End of the World.
الرمزية في 2026: أصبح الفيديو "أيقونة" ثقافية تعبر عن التمرد أو العزلة الوجودية لدى مستخدمي وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، حيث يتم تداوله مع تعليقات تشير إلى "الرغبة في الهروب من الضغوط" أو "المشي نحو المجهول".
التفسير العلمي: يرجح العلماء أن هذا السلوك ناتج عن خلـل في نظام الملاحة الداخلي للبطريق (GPS داخلي)، مما يؤدي إلى ضلاله الطريق ومواصلة السير بعيدًا نحو الداخل الجليدي رغم محاولات البشر أحيانًا لإعادة توجيهه.
كما ظهر مؤخرًا (يناير 2026) فيديو آخر لبطريقين يفسحان الطريق لبعضهما على "ممر ثلجي"، وهو ما اعتبر مشهدًا يعكس "التعاون" بين الحيوانات لتوفير الطاقة.

Cloud layer stratification refers to the formation of multiple cloud layers at different altitudes within the atmosphere, each possessing distinct temperature and moisture characteristics. These layers do not exist independently but continuously interact, shaping overall weather behavior.

In upper atmospheric levels, temperatures are significantly lower, leading to the formation of ice crystals, while lower layers may consist of supercooled water droplets. This vertical variation creates a complex structure within the cloud system.

As precipitation develops, particles may pass through several layers, undergoing transformations that influence their final form. These interactions can enhance or suppress precipitation intensity depending on the conditions present.

Changes in atmospheric stability, humidity, and temperature gradients determine how these layers evolve over time. Even slight variations can alter cloud thickness and precipitation patterns.

Understanding cloud stratification allows meteorologists to better interpret multi-layered weather systems and predict how precipitation will behave as it moves through the atmosphere.

node.text:
Follow @explainingflights to see how raw speed really compares across machines.

What looks like a casual lineup turns into a lesson in physics. Cars and bikes explode off the line with instant traction and acceleration, while the jet starts slower as its engines build thrust. But once the aircraft gains speed, the advantage flips completely.

Jets are designed for sustained acceleration and extreme top speeds, converting massive engine thrust into forward motion as drag decreases. On the runway, it’s a reminder that quick launches don’t equal ultimate speed — and why nothing on wheels truly keeps up once an aircraft commits to the run.

Different machines, different strengths… same obsession with speed.
#americanreels

ご存知ですか？日本では今、「歩く足跡」から発電しています！⚡ 日本では現在、一歩ごとに発生するエネルギーを電気に変換する圧電タイルが設置されています！🔋 人がこれらのタイルの上を歩くと、体重と動きによってタイルに圧力がかかり、タイルがわずかに曲がり、機械的な応力が生じます。タイル内の特殊な素材がこの圧力を電荷に変換します。⚙️ 一歩ごとに少量の電気が生成されますが、何百万人もの人が毎日歩く場合（東京の渋谷駅では1日240万歩以上！）、LEDライト、ディスプレイ、さらにはセンサーに電力を供給するのに十分なエネルギーが生成されます！💡🌱 この技術は、未来の都市が一歩ごとに「充電」されることを示しています。想像してみてください。もし私たちの都市がこのようなタイルで覆われていたら、私たちの動きだけで発電できるのでしょうか？ ⚡  日本は圧力電気磁器を使用して電気エネルギーを歩行に変換します。これらの磁器レンガは、歩行のエネルギーを捉えます。歩くと、体重と動きによって磁器に圧力がかかります。磁器はわずかに曲がり、これにより機械的応力が生じます。セラミックタイル内の加圧された材料が、この応力を電気エネルギーに変換します。一歩ごとに少量の電荷が発生しますが、数百万歩を組み合わせると、駆動するのに十分な電力を生成できます。 LEDライト、デジタルディスプレイ、センサー。涩谷駅のような混雑した場所では、1日約240人が利用します。このシステムは10万歩に貢献しています。この電気は貯蔵またはすぐに使用することができ、従来の電源への依存を減らし、持続可能な都市インフラをサポートします。この方法は、日常の活動を利用可能な再生可能エネルギーに変換します。  日本は圧力電気磁器を使用して電気エネルギーを歩行に変換します。これらの磁器レンガは、歩行のエネルギーを捉えます。歩くと、体重と動きによって磁器に圧力がかかります。磁器はわずかに曲がり、機械的応力が生じます。セラミックタイル内部の加圧された材料が、この応力を電気エネルギーに変換します。一歩ごとに少量の電荷が発生しますが、数百万歩を組み合わせると、駆動するのに十分な電力を生成できます。 LEDライト、デジタルディスプレイ、センサー。涩谷駅のような混雑した場所では、1日約240人が利用します。このシステムは10万歩に貢献しています。この電気は貯蔵またはすぐに使用することができ、従来の電源への依存を減らし、持続可能な都市インフラをサポートします。 この方法は、日常の活動を利用可能な再生可能エネルギーに変換します。  日本は圧力電気磁器を使用して電気エネルギーを歩行に変換します。これらの磁器レンガは、歩行のエネルギーを捉えます。歩くと、体重と動きによって磁器に圧力がかかります。磁器はわずかに曲がり、これが機械的な応力を生み出します。セラミックタイル内部の加圧された材料は、この応力を電気エネルギーに変換します。一歩ごとに微量の電荷が発生しますが、数百万歩を合わせると、LEDライト、デジタルディスプレイ、センサーを動かすのに十分な電力を生成できます。涩谷駅のような混雑した場所では、1日あたり約240人が利用します。このシステムは10万歩に貢献しています。この電力は貯蔵またはすぐに使用することができ、従来の電源への依存を減らし、持続可能な都市インフラをサポートします。この方法は、日常の活動を利用可能な再生可能エネルギーに変換します。

How to Detect Deception Primer // draft

#tradecraft #communicationskills #operatorasfuck #lifehacks #readingpeople
Successful interviews are a rollercoaster of emotions.
The Trick is to believe your own lies.
Thanks for the hints in how to lie better.
I told the truth I don’t have to make anything up I just remember it .

People misremember, get nervous, or communicate poorly. The only thing that starts to matter is pattern + deviation from baseline + context over time. Without that, you’re just projecting meaning onto normal human behavior !

node.text:
Everyone blames the woman when TTC fails — until they see this.

Male fertility is HALF of the equation. Smoking slashes sperm count, tanks motility, and fragments sperm DNA — making conception harder and miscarriage risk higher. The good news? Sperm regenerates every ~74 days. Three smoke-free months can flip the picture completely.

Save this and send it to him. His 35 matters just as much as yours.

(male fertility, sperm quality, smoking and fertility, TTC tips, trying to conceive, male factor infertility, sperm count, sperm motility, partner fertility, preconception health, men's fertility, DNA fragmentation, fertility journey, egg quality, how to improve sperm quality)

#fertilityjourney #ttctips #malefertility #preconceptionhealth #spermhealth

Cell Broadcast is a system for sending mass messages over cellular networks, where messages are transmitted from cell towers to all devices within a specific area without targeting individual phone numbers. The message is created at a central entity called the Cell Broadcast Center (CBC) and distributed to base stations, which broadcast it over a dedicated channel separate from SMS.
These messages do not go through traditional SMS systems, cannot be replied to, and often appear as emergency alerts.
devices like IMSI catchers, which act as fake cell towers, can trick nearby phones into connecting and then send messages to those devices within range. However, this is not true Cell Broadcast, but a limited simulation that requires advanced equipment.

Cell Broadcast هو نظام لبث الرسائل الجماعية ضمن شبكات الاتصالات، حيث يتم إرسال الرسالة من الأبراج الخلوية إلى جميع الأجهزة ضمن منطقة معينة دون الحاجة إلى أرقام هواتف. يتم إنشاء الرسالة في مركز مركزي داخل الشبكة (CBC) ثم تُوزع على الأبراج لتبثها مباشرة للأجهزة عبر قناة منفصلة عن SMS.
هذه الرسائل لا تمر عبر نظام الرسائل التقليدي، ولا يمكن الرد عليها، وغالبًا تظهر كتنبيهات طوارئ.
 يمكن لأجهزة مثل IMSI Catcher، التي تتصرف كبرج اتصالات مزيف، خداع الهواتف القريبة للاتصال بها، ومن ثم إرسال رسائل للأجهزة ضمن نطاقها. لكن هذا ليس Cell Broadcast حقيقي، بل محاكاة محدودة تتطلب معدات متقدمة.#الأمن_السيبراني #cybersecurity

How to Become Who You Actually Want to Be

1. Identity
Habits don’t change until identity does
Identity → values → actions → habits → outcomes
Start there.

2. Self Care
Self care isn’t hot baths
It’s how you talk to yourself when no one’s watching.

3. Avoidance
What you avoid controls you
What you face frees you
The fear only grows when you run.

4. Execution
Make it exist first
Make it good later.
You can’t improve what doesn’t exist yet.

5. Learning Before Earning
You want to monetise in 2 weeks
Your competitor has 5 years on you.
Learn first. Earn later.

node.text:
Today marks the 88th death anniversary of Allama Iqbal. He was a radical thinker, a sharp lawyer, and a man who bridged the gap between Western logic and Eastern soul. He was the one who dared to tell a colonized people that their “khudi” (selfhood) was more powerful than any empire. He didn’t live to see the country he dreamed of, but his spirit is woven into the very fabric of our identity. Today, we aren’t just remembering a poet; we are remembering the architect of our intellectual freedom.

Check out our latest slides for facts that prove Iqbal was far more than just a man with a pen.

Due to her family’s lack of social media presence, she was able to keep her online activity a secret from her religious family until her brother exposed her secret.

This has caused mixed opinions as this goes directly against many beliefs within the Muslim community. Do you think her brother was in the right to out her to her mother?
This is so staged and the amount of people falling for it is just sad
Anyways it kinda look staged but who care everyone loves gossip thats why everyone is watching it
Okay but what will happen if her mother knows about her girlfriend @aishahsofey @summerxiris 💀
Good on her , hope she leaves this toxic family 🥴
Muslim’s don’t belong in western civilization.
I see not one part of her body besides her face and her mom is that upset is crazy.
Wait he hurt his mom or the sister did? He was transparent with his mother and his sister was not.

Most people think deleting a post or clearing their history makes them invisible. It doesn't. From hidden metadata in your photos to your Wi-Fi signal's physical location, the "invisible" web remembers everything.

​Knowledge is your best defense. Use these to audit yourself before someone else does

node.text:
Он влюбился  в нее еще до реальной встречи, — через письма, которые она писала от руки, с таинственной  нежностью и истомой, поэтому одни скажут: «Бонни Кастл — аферистка», но, как по мне, — это чистокровная ворожба чужими фантазиями, в которые потом она поймалась сама [как обычно и бывает с женщинами, вставшими на путь игры], но к чему же это привело? 

…К чувствам.

Ведь когда долго играешь с мужской глубиной, тебе придется все-таки однажды восхититься ею и влюбиться самой [такой круговорот любви в природе]. Впрочем, без чувств ни одна игра не имеет никакого смысла. 

Как именно она писала эти письма?

Сегодня в моем закрытом дневнике ART OF INFLUENCE она сама расскажет об этом 🃏 переходи по ссылке в шапке профиля, чтобы вступить 🔗

node.text:
One man allegedly built one of the biggest digital ad fraud empires in history — from an apartment.

Aleksandr Zhukov created fake websites, fake traffic, fake viewers, and fake engagement so convincing that major advertisers unknowingly paid millions.

His bots simulated human behavior better than many websites track today. They scrolled, clicked, watched videos, and even solved CAPTCHAs.

At peak, the operation reportedly generated $5 million a day. Not from selling products. Not from creating content. From exploiting weaknesses in digital advertising systems.

This case exposed a massive problem in online marketing: billions in ad spend can disappear into fake impressions, fake clicks, and non-human traffic.

Even in 2026, ad fraud remains one of the internet’s biggest hidden industries.

Would this scam still work today?

Follow for more tech stories, cyber cases, and hidden internet history.

#CyberSecurity #TechNews #DigitalMarketing #InternetHistory #AI
And of course $0 refunded to advertisers by ad platforms

stop paying for VPNs… seriously. VPN companies are either lying about their log retention, privacy policy, or just flat out unethically selling user data. Not to mention, some are even being bought out by major institutions and private companies to assert control over privacy. 

In other words… they know your every move you make on the internet when you’re using their VPN “services”. If you’re going to spend money anyways… spend it right the first time!

node.text:
Turkish politician Orhan Avcı has gone viral after his official photo began circulating online following his appointment as head of the Huzur Party’s district branch.

One user wrote “there’s a face on his moustache,” while others compared him to Super Mario and Thomson and Thompson from Tintin. Some joked it was the result of one of Turkey’s famous hair transplants gone south, and others pointed out that at least nobody would ever be able to read his lips.

Moustaches carry deep cultural and political significance in Turkey, with different styles historically tied to different political identities. But regardless of which side of the spectrum Avcı falls on, the internet has unanimously agreed on one thing: that is an absolutely legendary moustache.

node.text:
This image presents itself as a joke, but underneath the humor lies a sharp commentary on how deeply polarized gender discourse has become in the digital age. By proposing a literal geographic separation of men and women into two distinct “states,” it exaggerates the idea of division to an absurd extreme—yet that exaggeration feels uncomfortably close to reality. Online spaces today often function like ideological territories, where interaction between genders can feel more like conflict than coexistence. The “buffer zone” becomes a darkly ironic symbol, reducing human connection to something transactional and mechanical, almost like a controlled system rather than a natural relationship.
Psychologically, the meme taps into a growing sense of fatigue and frustration—this quiet feeling that understanding between genders is breaking down. The use of a world map gives the idea a false sense of logic and order, as if something chaotic and emotional could be solved with clean lines and borders. That contrast is what makes it unsettling. It reflects a mindset where complex human relationships are simplified into binaries: us vs them, blue vs pink. The humor is ironic, but the undertone is serious—it mirrors how easily people slip into division when communication fails. In the end, the image isn’t really about geography; it’s about emotional distance, disguised as a “solution.”

node.text:
This is what it takes to be a neurosurgeon. 🧠
Watch the precision. Every single movement is deliberate, controlled, and calculated. There is no room for error — not even a millimeter of it.
Neurosurgeons operate in spaces smaller than a grain of rice, on structures responsible for everything that makes you human. Your ability to move, speak, think, feel, remember — all of it runs through the tissue they're working on.
One wrong cut doesn't mean a complication. It can mean paralysis. It can mean loss of speech. It can mean the person on that table never wakes up the same.
That's not pressure. That's the job. Every single day.
The average neurosurgeon trains for 14-16 years before they're trusted to operate alone. Their hands are insured. Their focus is inhuman. Their margin for error is zero.
Now you know why they get paid what they get paid. 💡

node.text:
The image captures a viral social media post that touches on a poignant, relatable phenomenon: the "gifted child burnout." The core message suggests that children who performed at a 12th-grade reading level while only in 4th grade often struggle with depression and a perceived loss of ability in adulthood. This sentiment is reinforced by a comment explaining that high-IQ children require constant stimulation to prevent them from "falling off the curve," potentially leading to anxiety when their environment fails to challenge them. This resonates with a generation of adults who feel they peaked in elementary school, only to be crushed by the weight of high expectations and a lack of support for their neurodivergence or advanced cognitive needs.
The image reflects a broader cultural conversation about how we measure intelligence and success in early education. When a child is labeled "gifted," the focus often shifts to their output rather than their emotional well-being. Over time, the lack of tailored curriculum or emotional guidance can lead to a sense of stagnation. This meme serves as a digital meeting ground for those who feel that their early academic prowess was a double-edged sword, leaving them feeling "illiterate" or exhausted as they navigate the complexities of adult life.
Then only the neurotypical smart kids got that additional support

@joshrup69420 painfully real. I remember it. The pace of class set by the kid with the lowest grades. The teachers trying to help them, but being over worked. So it landed to classmates to help. But you know what 8yo kids don’t know how to do? Help with math. So the smarter kids (at least where I was) ended up basically doing the other kids schoolwork. It got bad enough I was pulled and homeschooled.

node.text:
This video of the SignAloud gloves (often attributed to MIT students because of the prize they won) is a masterclass in solving a “Human Friction” problem.
The 99% see a “cool gadget.” The 1% see the elimination of a communication barrier for 70 million people. Created by Thomas Pryor and Navid Azodi (winners of the Lemelson-MIT Student Prize), these gloves don’t just track movement; they translate the complex, nuanced gestures of American Sign Language (ASL) into spoken English in real-time.
The end of the language barrier is being coded right now. 🦾🗣️
While the world is distracted by AI chatbots that write poetry, these builders used AI to give a voice to the silent. By using a network of sensors and “Statistical Regression” (similar to a neural network), the system maps hand positions to words instantly.
The Signal:
• Real-Time Latency: Near-instant translation from gesture to speech.
• Ergonomic Design: Built to be worn like a hearing aid or contact lenses—not a bulky computer.
• Neural Mapping: Deciphers X, Y, and Z coordinates of every finger move.
• The Mission: Proving that communication isn’t a privilege—it’s a fundamental human right.
The tools changed. The goal is the same: Building a world where everyone can be heard.

Follow @foundx.ai for the daily signal. 

#Foundx #SignLanguage #AI2026 #SiliconValley

node.text:
Everyone talks about talent.
But talent isn’t the bottleneck.

India produces millions of engineers.
Some of the best in the world.

Yet most global products still come from the same few countries.

So what’s missing?

It’s not skill.
It’s product thinking.

Building for users, not just requirements.
Taking risks, not just executing tasks.

It’s ecosystem.

Access to capital.
Mentors who’ve done it before.
A culture that rewards long-term bets, not short-term output.

It’s ownership mindset.

From service providers
→ to product creators
→ to category leaders.

Because writing code scales.
But building products changes the world.

The real question is…

When the mindset shifts,
how fast could everything change? 🚀

Follow @sonanos.news if you want to stay ahead of where tech is really going.

David Beckham and Victoria Beckham are one of the most iconic and enduring celebrity couples in pop culture history. From the late 1990s, when David rose to global fame as a football superstar and Victoria dominated music charts as Posh Spice of the Spice Girls, to building a powerful family empire, their relationship has remained in the public eye for decades.

What sets the Beckhams apart is the balance between glamour and authenticity. Their playful interviews, lighthearted teasing, and viral moments show a genuine, down-to-earth dynamic that fans connect with. They consistently support each other’s careers, prioritize their children, and present a united front despite constant media attention.

In an industry where celebrity marriages often struggle under pressure, David and Victoria Beckham’s long-lasting relationship stands out as a symbol of loyalty, mutual respect, and partnership. Their story continues to resonate as proof that real love in Hollywood can last when it’s built on friendship, humor, and shared history.

node.text:
This Venn diagram offers a darkly comedic exploration of the unexpected overlaps between three seemingly disparate groups: Doctors, Writers, and Serial Killers. The humor is rooted in the "occupational hazards" and shared traits that link healing, creativity, and criminality. At the top, Doctors and Serial Killers meet at the chilling realization that both "can easily end human lives," though their motivations are polar opposites. On the left, Doctors and Writers share the grueling necessity to "research a lot," whether it is to save a patient or to craft a believable narrative. On the bottom, Writers and Serial Killers are hilariously united by their "suspicious search histories," a nod to the crime novelist's need to look up untraceable poisons or body decomposition rates—queries that would certainly raise eyebrows at an IT department or a police station.
​The centerpiece of the diagram, where all three circles converge, provides the punchline: they all "know more about the human body than normal people ever should." This suggests a level of anatomical intimacy that moves beyond general knowledge into the realm of the clinical, the obsessive, or the macabre. By placing a noble profession like medicine alongside the dark arts of fiction and the horrors of true crime, the meme highlights how expertise and information are neutral tools; it is the intent behind them that defines the individual. It’s a witty commentary on how specialized knowledge can make one an outlier in polite society, regardless of whether you are trying to write a bestseller, pass a board exam, or hide a body.

Hehehe just pure magic! Basking in whale breath😆😆😆 ahhhh I love them so much! And was sooooo happy to sing to them and play our 528 hz frequency wand! Eeep love and miracles abound! 
(This beautiful handmade wand is available now in our online store @soulstar.singing.bowls)

If you’re new here….(welcome!)…my name is Demetra.

I travel the world singing with whales and dolphins and often record their responses. Later, we weave their songs into the long sound healing journeys we create using crystal bowls, crystal harps, my voice, and whale songs… the most healing frequencies of all.

Follow along if you love whales, healing frequencies, and the magic of the ocean. 🐋

I just love them so much!🥹✨

~

I also design my own line of handmade gemstone infused crystal singing bowls and play them in nature, often singing with whales and dolphins.

These bowls are handmade, infused with various gemstones, and precisely tuned to powerful healing frequencies.

You can receive them tuned to 432 hz or 528 hz, and we also offer Solfeggio frequencies and specific planetary frequencies… like the frequency of Venus💓.

These are the same bowls we use in the sound healing journeys we create…. Available on our website 😌🪽💎

~

I truly believe whale songs are meant to be heard, felt, and integrated.

They carry deeeep medicine for our world.

Their songs feel like messages carried through the water… waiting for us to remember who we truly are!🌊🐋 Their frequencies activate and attune us home to truth! 

~

Comment WHALE MAGIC and I’ll send you the link to the whale sound healing recordings. 🐋✨

Comment CRYSTAL MAGIC and I’ll send you the link to the crystal bowl store. 💎

Sending so much love and gratitude ~
Demetra ✨
Thank you! I just sent the link to your DMs. 🥰

node.text:
"What separates us from criminals is intention. The cause we serve."

That statement was true but incomplete.

Once actions are translated into data, once lives are rendered comparable, the moral distinction that separates the HUMINT operator from the criminal disappears from the system's field of vision.

The consequence is operational, temporal, and irreversible. From now on, the past is pending reinterpretation.

For HUMINT, this raises a set of dangerous questions: what happens to an operative when their entire life becomes re-readable, years later, under a different analytical regime? how do you live (not operate, but live) when your biography itself becomes the exposure surface?

But, this is not a HUMINT-only problem. For those who are not intelligence professionals, the implication is just as unsettling:

What in your life today may form a trajectory recognizable by a system tomorrow?
What do you believe is "private" simply because it has not yet been connected?
Your secrets are not what you think they are anymore.

Stay lucid,

Oriane

A viral video shared by @TheProjectUnity showcases the surprising process of extracting real gold from discarded SIM cards. Using acid baths, filtration, and smelting, a recycler processes massive quantities of old SIMs- each containing tiny amounts of gold plating (typically 1- 8 mg per card) for reliable contacts. The dramatic result: a shiny 310g gold bar worth thousands. While mesmerizing and highlighting e-waste value, the labor- intensive, hazardous method (involving dangerous chemicals) and sheer volume required make it impractical for most people-more educational spectacle than get-rich-quick scheme.

#GoldRecovery #SIMCards #EWaste #PreciousMetals
we becomin jewish with this one

@ano_nymus16 You would need a minimum of 13 SIM cards for just $1 usd worth of gold. The amount to get what you saw in the video, which equaled 310 grams of gold, would requiere over 620,000 SIM cards. Not practical for most people.

Princess Diana visited Pakistan several times and showed clear respect for Islamic culture and values. She dressed modestly, covered her head when appropriate, and carried herself with dignity—reflecting an appreciation for the principles of Islam such as modesty, respect, and compassion. Her visits, along with her connection to Imran Khan, brought her closer to a society deeply rooted in Islamic teachings. Although she never publicly stated a personal religious influence, her actions spoke of admiration. Many saw in her behavior a quiet acknowledgment of Islam’s beauty, especially its emphasis on humility, charity, and human dignity.

The dramatic incident highlighted the protective instincts often seen in animals, leaving viewers stunned. Witnesses were left in disbelief as the rare interaction played out, showing both the unpredictable nature of wildlife and the surprising display of defense. The video has since gone viral, sparking intense reactions and debates across social media platforms worldwide.

node.text: The image presents a visual metaphor for the "painting yourself into a corner" fallacy, typically used to illustrate a lack of foresight or planning. The top caption uses the scenario as a cautionary tale about the importance of having an exit strategy before embarking on a task. However, the lower commentary subverts this traditional wisdom by offering a pragmatic, time-based solution: simply waiting for the environment to change (the paint to dry) to complete the work. This transformation of a "dead end" into a "pause" shifts the moral focus from the paralysis of perfectionism to the value of momentum and adaptability. It suggests that many perceived insurmountable obstacles are merely temporary constraints that can be solved with patience and iterative progress. This interaction highlights a common tension in modern productivity discourse between "measure twice, cut once" traditionalism and the "fail fast, pivot later" mindset of the digital age.

Orange lenses enhance contrast, improve depth perception, and reduce glare — helping you see road details faster, especially in low light, cloudy weather, or golden hour drives.

Sharper vision. Smoother drive. Elevated style.

node.text:
🎥 Still Game (2002–2019) is a Scottish sitcom created by Ford Kiernan and Greg Hemphill, produced by BBC Scotland. The series stars Ford Kiernan as Jack Jarvis and Greg Hemphill as Victor McDade, alongside Jane McCarry, Mark Cox, Paul Riley, and Gavin Mitchell.

The show became one of the most beloved sitcoms in the UK, building a massive and loyal fanbase over the years. Still Game is widely known for its sharp humor, relatable characters, and authentic portrayal of everyday life, with Jack and Victor’s friendship at the heart of the series.

Since its original run, the show has remained highly popular through reruns, streaming platforms, and viral clips shared across social media. Quotes, iconic scenes, and comedic moments from Still Game continue to trend online, especially among longtime fans and new viewers discovering the series.

With its cultural impact, strong online presence, and timeless humor, Still Game remains one of the most rewatched, quoted, and widely loved sitcoms of its era.

Complex Analysis YouTube playlists

• Taking Complex Analysis this semester?

Don’t stress, here are some key playlists to make it way easier 

Steve Brunton : Crash Course in Complex Analysis (engineering-focused, clear explanations)

The Bright Side of Mathematics : Complete Complex
Analysis series (visual + rigorous)

MathMajor : Step-by-step full lectures (great for beginners)

Richard Borcherds : Cambridge Professor’s course (theory-heavy, deep insights)

Mathemaniac : Essence of Complex Analysis (visual + intuitive)

The Math Coach : Full Complex Analysis Lectures (tons of examples + proots)

- Save this so you can come back during revision week!

Follow @pk4t0 for more.

node.text:
The provided image captures a viral exchange on X (formerly Twitter) centered on the Grand Theft Auto (GTA) franchise, highlighting a polarizing intersection of gaming culture, morality, and social commentary. The thread begins with a user named Dan listing the mainline GTA titles he has never played, which prompts a notable response from Elon Musk. Musk explains his personal aversion to the series, specifically citing the opening prologue of GTA V—which necessitates a shootout with police during a heist—as a moral dealbreaker that prevented him from continuing. This sentiment is echoed by media personality Ian Miles Cheong, who contrasts GTA's mandatory violence against law enforcement with the more "optional" nature of such encounters in Cyberpunk 2077.
​However, the exchange takes a sharp, satirical turn with the final comment from user Kristi Yamaguccimane. Using provocative and hyperbolic humor, the user delivers a scathing "ratio," mocking the three men for their perceived sensitivity toward fictional, scripted video game crimes. The contrast between the serious, high-profile tone of Musk’s moral stance and the blunt, irreverent insult of the final reply encapsulates the chaotic and often adversarial nature of public discourse on social media platforms. The post serves as a snapshot of how even mainstream entertainment choices can become a stage for debating personal ethics and performative masculinity.

By choosing what matters to us, we decide what our experiences mean, so every moment can become whatever we choose to make of it.

극심한 폭염과 ‘도시 열섬 현상’에 대응하기 위해, 시는 검은 아스팔트 도로 표면에 특수 반사 도료를 적용하고 있습니다. 이 간단한 방법으로 태양열을 흡수하는 대신 우주로 반사시켜, 도로 표면 온도를 최대 약 15도까지 낮출 수 있습니다. 이는 도시를 식히고, 혹독한 여름에 사람들의 생명을 보호하기 위한 대규모 실험입니다

node.accessibility_caption: Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 15, 2026. May be pop art of poster, magazine and text that says 'WHY STATES CAN'T TRUST EACH OTHER (The Mearsheimer Perspective). Pak PakImtehan Imtehan'.
Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 15, 2026. May be a graphic of poster and text.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 15, 2026. May be a graphic of poster, magazine and text that says 'CSS/PAKIMTEHAN CSS PAK IMTEHAN THE '9-1-1" PROBLEM In domestic politics, if someone robs you, you call the police (the 9-1-1 emer emergency system). In international politics, there is no 9-1-1. a superpower decides to invade a smaller neighbor, there is no higher power that can guaranteed-ly intervene to stop them. Because states cannot dial for help, they must rely on Self- Help. To be safe, they must be strong.'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 15, 2026. May be a graphic of poster, magazine and text that says 'css CSS|PAKIMTEHAN |PAK IMTEHAN 3. THE SECURITY DILEMMA This is the mechanical core of why trust is impossible. When State A increases its military capabilities for purely defensive reasons (e.g., buying a new missile defense system), State B views this as a potential threat. ·State B cannot read State A's mind. State B responds by increasing its own military power. •State A sees State B's response and feels even more insecure. This creates a spiral of insecurity" where the actions taken by states to increase their security actually decrease the overall security of the system.'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 15, 2026. May be a graphic of money, poster, card and text that says '4. RELATIVE GAINS VS. ABSOLUTE GAINS In a trusting environment (Liberalism), if two states trade and both get richer, it's a win-win. However, Mearsheimer argues that states care about Relative Gains. If China's economy grows by 10% and the US economy grows by 5%, the US may feel it is "losing' because that wealth can be converted into military power. Trust IS discarded because cooperation might help a rival more than it helps you, shifting the balance of power お$ $ $'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 15, 2026. May be an image of magazine, poster and text that says '5. The Ultimate Goal: Hegemony Since you can never trust your neighbor and you can never be sure how much power is "enough" to stay safe, the only logical conclusion for a state is to become as powerful as possible. The "Gold Standard" of survival is to become a Hegemon, the only great power in the system. If you are the strongest, no one can threaten you, and the "trust" issue becomes irrelevant because you no longer depend on the goodwill of others.'.

Photo by Pak Imtehan on April 15, 2026. May be an image of knife and text that says 'Conflict is not a choice; it isa is structural byproduct of a world where no one is in charge and everyone has a knife. PakImtehan Pak 2'.

This viral exchange perfectly captures the age-old debate regarding how early exposure to specific operating systems shapes our cognitive development and technical troubleshooting abilities. The original poster, Annie, suggests a correlation study between children raised on Mac versus Windows computers to see if one leads to higher tech illiteracy or weaker problem-solving skills later in life. The underlying theory is that "walled garden" ecosystems might stifle the curiosity required to understand how systems actually function. However, the thread takes a hilarious and sharp turn when a user mentions installing Linux at age twelve—a feat of digital endurance that usually involves hours of troubleshooting and terminal commands. Annie’s quick-witted reply about excluding certain demographics from the study to avoid skewing the data highlights a popular internet trope: the "tech wizard" archetype. It’s a witty commentary on how we learn to navigate the digital world and the different paths to computer literacy.
#TechHumor #LinuxUser #MacVsWindows #ComputerScience #InternetCulture

node.text:
Most people install random extensions…
but don’t realize how powerful the right ones can be.

These tools don’t make you a hacker —
but they make your workflow faster, smarter, and more efficient.

From recon to testing, everything becomes easier when your browser is set up properly.

If you’re serious about learning hacking the right way,
tools + guidance both matter.

I’ve also shared my Full Ethical Hacking Course inside this post 👀

If you want access to it:
👉 Comment “Course” below ⬇️

node.text:
Two humanoid robots walk into a café… and suddenly it looks like a scene straight out of an action movie. 🤖☕

What feels like a spontaneous fight is actually precision engineering at work. These Unitree G1 robots aren’t making decisions or holding grudges — they’re executing pre-trained motion sequences with advanced balance control, walking autonomy, and environmental awareness, all under human supervision.

That’s what makes it fascinating. The movements look natural enough to fool the brain into believing intent exists. No rivalry. No emotion. Just code, training data, and hardware mimicking conflict so convincingly that simulation starts to feel real. The gap between choreography and autonomy is shrinking fast.

👉 Follow @executing.ai for more moments where AI and robotics blur the line between reality and illusion.

🎬 Clip credit: Unknown | DM for credit/removal

node.text:
Fingerprint scanners 👆 are biometric systems that identify you using unique patterns on your fingers.
.
Every fingerprint has ridges, valleys, and minutiae points that are nearly impossible to replicate.
.
1️⃣ Capture — sensor takes an image or reads the fingerprint pattern
2️⃣ Types — optical (light), capacitive (electric charge), ultrasonic (sound waves)
3️⃣ Feature Extraction — key points like ridge endings & bifurcations are detected
4️⃣ Template Creation — fingerprint data is converted into a digital map
5️⃣ Matching — scanned print is compared with stored template for verification
.
It doesn’t store your actual fingerprint image — only a mathematical representation.
That’s why it’s fast, secure, and widely used in phones and security systems.
.
.
.

node.text:
Chinese robotics company Unitree is showing off what its robots can do, with CEO Wang Xingxing personally training them to perform stunts like jumps, backflips, and running. His confidence highlights the safety and precision of these machines.

Robots like these are part of a larger revolution, becoming faster, more agile, and capable of complex tasks once thought impossible. The line between science fiction and reality is quickly fading as robots push the limits of what machines can do.

Yet as robots grow more advanced, questions about safety arise. While designed for reliability, highly capable machines could be dangerous if misused. The challenge will be using these innovations responsibly for the benefit of humanity.

#ai #robotics #humanoidrobots #airevolution #technology

کاش اگر ہر گھر تھوڑا سا کھانا انکو دے تو یہ بے زبان آخرت میں اپنے کھانا دینے والوں کی نجات ھونگے شائید لوگوں کو سمجھ آ جائےلوگ خوف خدا بھولتے جا رہے ہیں اسلیے بیماریاں اور مسائل اس ملک کا پیچھا چھوڑنے کو تیار نہیں۔کیا یہ احساس ایک خزانے سے کم نہیں ہے کہ یہ چھوٹی چھوٹی خوبصورت روحیں ہمیں اِن کی میزبانی کے قابل سمجھتے ہوئے ہمیں یہ شرف بخشتی ہیں اور ویسے بھی تو اللہ کی یہ مخلوق خاص خاص لوگوں کو ہی اس قابل سمجھتی ہیں اور باقی رہی جزا کی بات تو ہمیں میرا رّب حضرت ابو حریرہ رض کے صدقے میں (بلّیوں کے باپ )(لقب) اس امر کا اجر عطا فرمائے کیونکہ اللہ کے نبی نے فرمایا کہ جس گھر میں بلّیاں آتی ہوں وہاں رزق کی کبھی کمی نہیں ہوتی تو آپ کو اللہ کا مشکور ہونا چاہیئے کہ آپکے حصے میں یہ کارِ خیر آتا ہے

node.text:
In 1997, Ukrainian TV accidentally captured rave history.

A film crew documenting nightlife in Kharkiv, Ukraine recorded a segment inside a local nightclub, where a young boy in sunglasses and a turtleneck danced with effortless confidence, unaware he was about to become a rave icon.

Years later, the clip resurfaced online and went viral, turning into one of the internet’s most recognizable rave moments.

Proof that sometimes the most iconic moments aren’t planned, they just happen.

node.text:
This viral video captures a man repeatedly attempting to flee a pursuing Belgian Malinois through a kennel gate, creating a comedic "infinity loop" as the dog's relentless energy traps him in a cycle of evasion, filmed at what appears to be a dog training facility.

An account specialising in absurd, decontextualised human moments, the clip amassed over 8 million views and 34,000 likes within weeks, highlighting the breed's renowned stamina—Belgian Malinois can sustain high-intensity activity for up to 30 minutes without fatigue, per veterinary studies on working dogs.

Replies blend humour with practical advice, such as closing the gate firmly or tiring the dog out, underscoring the video's appeal as light-hearted escapism amid everyday frustrations, while sparking discussions on canine behaviour and owner mishaps.

Dangerous Safety Myth - This picture is a clear sign of how society deals with the constant fear of physical harm. It takes a very complicated and scary situation and tries to make it feel manageable with one simple trick. For many years, people have looked for quick ways to feel safe, and this message gives them that feeling by pointing to a specific "weak spot" on the human body. It suggests that anyone can be powerful just by knowing where to press. This shows a desperation for easy answers to big, systemic problems. By spreading this around, people believe they are giving others a weapon of knowledge, but it really just shows a heavy reliance on unverified wisdom to handle deep anxieties. It makes a life-or-death struggle look like a simple game of finding the right button to push.
In these spaces, this kind of content is very popular because it feels like a hidden secret that official groups aren't sharing. The low-quality image and the basic writing make it look like a message from a regular person trying to help their community. However, this is part of a bigger problem where people trust a single image more than actual experts or physical training. In a high-stress moment, a single finger press is almost impossible to use correctly, yet the post promises it will work for everyone. This highlights how modern information culture often promotes "fast facts" that are easy to swallow but hard to use in the real world. It turns a serious talk about protection into a shared artifact used to feel like one is making a difference, even if the advice itself is not proven.
I will train for it so it won't work on me

node.text:
I walked away for 3 minutes…

THREE.

And came back to my 6-year-old bathing the baby in a steel bowl like she runs a daycare out of my kitchen. 😭😂

Big family moms know… the older ones don’t “play house.”
They start managing it.

Should I be concerned… or start paying her?

Follow me for more real-life mom chaos and big family moments 🤍

THE LOW T EPIDEMIC…

Testosterone levels in men have been steadily declining for decades- dropping up to 1% per year since the late ’80s. This isn’t just about libido or muscle mass. Low T is linked to fatigue, brain fog, depression, insulin resistance, increased body fat, and poor sleep.

The culprits? Endocrine-disrupting chemicals in skincare and plastics, chronic stress, poor sleep, pornography, nutrient deficiencies, and the overconsumption of seed oils and processed foods. Testosterone is foundational for physical vitality and mental clarity and fertility/ Stabilizing it isn’t about chasing a number; it’s about protecting your long-term health, resilience, and biological integrity BOYSS 🩵

Hey, great post! Few questions I’d really appreciate you answering :)

I am 19. What are some ways I can actually implement these while living with my parents?

I’m going to be getting hired part time soon so I’ll be able to buy a few items here and there but I’ll still mainly rely on my parents food. Any advice?

@rey_82389 It could be fairly easy depending on the lifestyle you’re all already living! Start with the basics if you’re not there already, small swaps for real fats/oils over seed oils, more whole foods etc, things that will easily also benefit them. Slowly swap out textiles and personal products as you can afford it. Prioritize sun, sleep and your body along the way 🙌
